synthesizedFacts.fact: Seborrheic dermatitis is a chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by flaky, white to yellowish scales on oily areas such as the scalp and face.
The condition is associated with an overgrowth of Malassezia yeast, which thrives in oily skin areas.
Seborrheic dermatitis can be managed with medicated shampoos and creams containing ingredients like ketoconazole, selenium sulfide, or corticosteroids.
Stress, fatigue, and seasonal changes can trigger flare-ups of seborrheic dermatitis.
